serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: DEMO/SAMPLE DATA. Example Case Manager is a fictional multi-tenant SaaS case-management service used to demonstrate SPARC's FedRAMP package exchange. Agencies track cases, attach documents and route approvals. The service runs in a single commercial cloud region pair with encrypted storage, centralized logging and phishing-resistant MFA for every user.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Example Cloud Works trust center: this package overview, the security decision record and every ongoing report, each in machine-readable JSON.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: Agencies request access by emailing trust-center@example.com from a .gov address; access is granted within two business days.

secureConfigurationGuidance.repositoryDescription: Secure configuration guide for agency administrators: SSO, MFA enforcement, retention settings and audit export.

additionalRepositories.repositoryDescription: Independent assessment results and the provider's security policies and procedures.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Create, assign and close cases with a full audit history.
Encrypted storage for case attachments, with retention rules per agency.
Scheduled case reports exported to the agency's data warehouse.

certified.useCase: Fictional FedRAMP Certified IaaS hosting all compute, storage and databases.

nonCertified.name: Example Mail Relay
nonCertified.useCase: Sends case-assignment notification email that carries no case content.
